A casual look at our team's open-source activity via [GitFut](https://gitfut.com/). Cards are based on recent GitHub activity.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'asis'
#| message: false

library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)

team <- read.csv("team.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Helper function to fetch score from GitFut meta tags
colnames(team) <- tolower(trimws(colnames(team)))

get_gitfut_score <- function(github_user) {
  if (is.null(github_user) || is.na(github_user) || trimws(github_user) == "") {
    return(0)
  }
  
  api_url <- paste0("https://gitfut.com/api/card/", trimws(github_user))
  
  tryCatch({
    res <- jsonlite::fromJSON(api_url)
    # Extract the overall rating from the API response
    score <- if (!is.null(res$overall)) res$overall else 0
    return(as.numeric(score))
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(0) # Fallback if user doesn't exist or API is unreachable
  })
}

# Fetch scores and arrange descending
team <- team |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(score = get_gitfut_score(github)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  arrange(desc(score))

cat("::: {.grid}\n\n")


for (i in seq_len(nrow(team))) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-sm-6 .g-col-md-3 .gitfut-card}\n[![%s](https://gitfut.com/%s.png)](https://github.com/%s)\n:::\n\n",
    team$name[i],
    team$github[i],
    team$github[i]
  ))
}

cat(":::\n")
```
